text:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a tiny docs PR to update the streaming pagination snippets across py/ts/go. It adds a resume-token example + exponential retry docs. @sam can you eyeball the Python/TS parts?

sam: On it. Which repo/PR number?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (WIP) — main changes in docs/snippets/streaming. I kept the old variant but added a 'migration note' block.

kevin: Quick note: Go example needs context cancellation + backpressure hint. I can push a small follow-up to the PR if you want.

sam: Saw the diff — TS looks fine but the retry backoff math isn't explicit. Can we include a tiny snippet for backoff (jittered)? e.g.
```ts
const backoff = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attempt + Math.random() * 200, 10000);
```

maria: Good call. I added a comment line but not the function — will add the snippet. Also added a one-line migration blurb for folks using legacy cursor API.

kevin: I'll add the Go context example:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
// pass ctx into StreamClient to ensure cancellation on consumer exit
```

sam: For Python, we should show both sync and async variants. Suggest keeping the sync one short and linking to an expanded async example elsewhere.

maria: Done — kept sync inline, linked to /snippets/streaming-async.md for details. Also fixed one broken anchor to "pagination-best-practices" that CI was complaining about.

docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link fixed (pagination-best-practices). CI: docs build passing locally.

sam: LGTM modulo the jitter example placement. If kevin can add the Go bit, we can merge after CI. :thumbsup:

kevin: Pushed the Go follow-up in the same PR branch — small commit with context pattern and a comment on batching.

maria: Thanks — merging after CI completes. Will follow up with a short announcement on #eng about the migration note so teams know about resume-token behavior.

sam: Thanks — will watch for any regression reports.

maria: (adding TODO) create a single cross-lang snippet that demonstrates resume token + retry strategy for common patterns. Filing a docs issue now.

(END)
